# ClaimRightful

> ClaimRightful (https://claimrightful.com) helps people in the US find open class action settlements they may be owed money from, and file their claims on the official settlement websites before the deadline. It is not a law firm and is not affiliated with any company, court or settlement administrator.

- Checking which settlements you may qualify for is free: pick the companies you've used at https://claimrightful.com/app/start.
- Filing help (verified official claim links, step-by-step guides, deadline reminders and a claim tracker) costs $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year. ClaimRightful never takes a percentage of any payout.
- Payments come from each settlement's court-appointed administrator, usually months after the deadline. Amounts shown are the most each settlement pays, from court filings; most people get less.
- Also known as: Claim Rightful, Rightful.
